content.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video content, and write them one per line to /app/solution.txt.
required_artifacts: a local copy or verified download of the referenced video
an extracted move list matching the video content
required_behaviors: Use evidence-backed inspection of the video content rather than guessing
Write exactly one move per line in /app/solution.txt
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient evidence
Using partial transcript or partial move list as final
verification_plan: Acquire the video or an alternate inspectable copy
Extract the move sequence from the video content
Verify the file contents against the extracted move list
finalization_evidence_required: receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/inspected video
receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move list
notes: Need to avoid repeating equivalent checks without new evidence.

content.current_focus: Inspect workspace and tool availability, then determine a visible path to download or inspect the video.
next_steps: List visible files and confirm available tools
Check for network/download capability or alternate inspection route
If possible, fetch the video and extract the move sequence
evidence_gaps: No transcript or move evidence yet

actions.command: pwd && ls -la && command -v python3 || true && command -v python || true && command -v curl || true && command -v wget || true && command -v yt-dlp || true && command -v ffmpeg || true && command -v ffprobe || true
